generate_benchmark_result_file_path: generate a benchmark result file path using PathMaker.result_file with faults, nodes, workers, collocate, rate, and tx_size parameters
generate_aggregated_plot_file_path: generate an aggregated plot file path using PathMaker.agg_file with benchmark parameters and optional max_latency
print_colored_benchmark_output: print colored benchmark output using Print.heading, Print.info, Print.warn, or Print.error with ANSI color codes
display_progress_bar: display a progress bar while iterating over an iterable using the progress_bar generator function
handle_benchmark_errors: handle benchmark errors using BenchError exception class with nested cause chaining and Print.error for display
